# Detail.vue Registered Unused Component Bug
In 苏州市房地产监测V3 project, companyAdmin/detail.vue registered RegisterUploadItem in components but did not import it and template unused, causing reference error.

## Root Cause
- companyAdmin/detail.vue components registered RegisterUploadItem without import
- Template did not use the component, redundant registration caused reference error

## Fix
- Deleted redundant registration of RegisterUploadItem
- Essential upload routed through AppendixPackageSection to restore routing

# SzForm Empty Validation Caused No Frontend Location
In 苏州市房地产监测V3 project, suzhou2016/mixins/szForm.js checkValidate() empty implementation caused no frontend validation on save and SzContent scroll to .is-error not triggered.

## Root Cause
- szForm.js checkValidate() empty implementation skipped frontend validation
- SzContent scroll to .is-error not triggered on save

## Fix
- Sz* components derive field name from v-model to render data-field anchor (components/fieldAnchor.js)
- SzContent.getFormData() validates per chapter, highlights first unfilled item, scrolls and interrupts save
- Required fields registered in suzhou2016/validation.js CHAPTER_REQUIRED by branch validation
- Channel 2 fallback intercepts backend errors

# Enterprise Detail Page Hardcoded busCode Caused Change Exception
In 苏州市房地产监测V3 project, enterprise model detail page hardcoded busCode caused process exception; fix uses route resolution helpers.

## Root Cause
- Enterprise model detail page hardcoded busCode leading to flow abnormality on change

## Fix
- Dev/agency detail pages call resolveCompanyRecordChangeFlowBusCode(route, organType)
- api/company/personnelRecord.js adds resolvePersonnelChangeBusCode for personnel detail page route resolution

# Tab Embedded Panel Must Use borderOnly to Avoid Title Duplication
In 苏州市房地产监测V3 project, Tab embedded detail panel downgraded to div loses border and duplicates title; Headline adds borderOnly prop.

## Root Cause
- Tab embedded detail page panel downgraded to div lost border and caused title duplication

## Fix
- Headline/index.vue adds borderOnly prop preserving .collapse-container outer frame and hiding title bar
- PermitInfoPanel.vue and three other components use this prop
- PresaleBuildingSection.vue and detail.vue top-level Tab changed to type="card"
